name: @intellectual-frontiers/kanon
description: Kanon, the pattern of a library built in three layers (governance, logical, physical): the type of a library's table of layers, the import check that holds it, the check that no annotation of governance is dropped, and the types-only LayeredModel contract. One rule, projected down, nothing lost.

scripts.verify: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun ../tools/mizan-check.ts --root spec-kit && bun ../libraries/src/check.ts --root spec-kit --level L1 && bun tools/check.ts && bun test suite/ && bun tools/pack.ts --check
